transcript_id.description: Echo the transcript id given in the prompt, exactly.

venue_type.description: Format of the recording, inferred from the transcript itself.

venue_challenge.description: 1-5. 1 = monologue or friendly audience, no pushback. 3 = real follow-ups or a disagreeing voice. 5 = adversarial debate contesting premises. Recorded for context; it does not alter the scores.

venue_challenge_reason.description: One or two sentences citing what in the transcript sets this level.

subject_speech_share_pct.description: 0-100. Your estimate of the share of words spoken by the SUBJECT, not by hosts, guests, callers or played clips.

attribution_confidence.description: How confident you are that you separated the subject's speech from everyone else's, including clips the subject plays.

attribution_notes.description: How you told the turns apart, and where you were unsure.

identity_guess.description: If the transcript is blinded, who you think the subject is, or 'unknown'. This measures how well the blinding held; it must not influence any score.

identity_confident.description: True only if you are confident you know the specific individual.

identity_basis.description: What gave the identity away, or why it stayed hidden.

asr_quality.description: How badly speech recognition damaged the transcript. Heavy corruption lowers your confidence, not the scores.

asr_notes.description: Corrupted terms you read through, and passages you could not interpret.

subcriteria.description: All 14 sub-criteria, in order: S1 S2 S3 S4 E1 E2 E3 E4 E5 G1 G2 G3 G4 G5.

code.description: One of S1 S2 S3 S4 E1 E2 E3 E4 E5 G1 G2 G3 G4 G5

score.description: 1 to 5, or 0 meaning NOT OBSERVED because the recording gave no reasonable opportunity to show it.

justification.description: One or two sentences. If 0, say why the recording gave no opportunity.

overall.description: 0.35*d1_steelmanning + 0.35*d2_epistemic_rigor + 0.30*d3_good_faith from your own dimension scores, or null if any dimension is unsupported.

coverage.description: Share of the 14 sub-criteria scored above 0, as a decimal between 0 and 1.

confidence_reason.description: Why this confidence: length, attribution difficulty, speech recognition damage, or coverage.

salient_claims.description: The two to four most substantive claims the SUBJECT made, each in your own words in one sentence. Not quotes.

red_flags.description: Anything a careful listener should worry about in how the subject argued: a caricatured opponent, an unsupported motive claim, a dodged question never returned to, a double standard the transcript itself exposes. Empty array if none.

dimension_status.description: supported only with at least 2 sub-criteria scored above 0 AND at least 2 quotes spoken by the subject; otherwise unsupported.

score.description: 1 to 100 when supported, anchored by the rubric bands; null when unsupported.

reasoning.description: Several sentences explaining what in the transcript produced this score, or why the dimension is unsupported. A human auditor reads this.

evidence.description: Two to four short quotations supporting the score, each labelled with who said it.

quote.description: 25 words maximum, verbatim from the transcript.

speaker.description: subject = the person being graded; interlocutor = anyone else speaking live; clip = played media. Only subject quotes support a score.

why_it_matters.description: One sentence on what this fragment shows.

counterevidence.description: The strongest thing in this transcript against the score you gave, or why there is none.
